name: Research to Reviewer Handoff
description: When a researcher loop completes successfully (completion message terminates the loop with outcome=success), spawn a research-reviewer loop to evaluate the artifact via reviewer-as-enumerator. The reviewer reads the prior loop's completion via read_loop_result, applies the active checklist, and emits decide(action=approved|insufficient). R1 of the ADR-031 phasing.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.research-review
on_enter.prompt: Evaluate the prior researcher loop's submission. Researcher loop id: $entity.id. Call read_loop_result with that loop id to fetch the artifact, apply the active checklist, then call decide(action="approved") if all required items are present, or decide(action="insufficient", reason="<bullet list of gaps>") otherwise.
